messages:
tyler: Heads up — after today's runtime merge (PR #4218) we're seeing a p95 decode slowdown on canary. Attn kernel chooser flipped to a new fused path and KV cache miss rate spiked.

infra-bot: CI perf job `canary/decode_p95` failed — +18% vs baseline (run 2026-03-18T10:12Z).

meenal: I reproduced on prod-sim. KVCache::evict_rate went from ~0.7/s to ~3.1/s for short-seq traffic. Prefetch warmup looks noisy.

jordan: bisect in progress. early pointer: commit 4f3b2a13 changed kernel selector heuristics (shortseq bias + fuse threshold). Running quick bisect now. :eyes:

sasha: can you paste a perf trace and scheduler logs? quick grep for `kernel_select` and `kv_cache` should show handoffs.

tyler: paste of local profile (tail):

```
# ./scripts/profile_decode --canary
flamegraph: decode_tail_syms -> kernel:attn_fused_shortseq  45%
kernel_switches: 120 -> to attn_fused_shortseq at t=00:02:31
KVCache::hits=1245 misses=897 evicts=432 evict_rate=3.2/s
scheduler: prefetched 0.6s, batch_wait 6ms, retry_count=3
```

log excerpt:
```
2026-03-18T10:09:11Z kernel_select: candidate=attn_fused_shortseq score=0.82
2026-03-18T10:09:11Z kv_cache: miss key=ctx-0x3f2 evict_count=1
2026-03-18T10:09:11Z fallback: switching kernel->attn_generic due to mem_pressure
```

jordan: bisect narrowed it to 4f3b2a13 -> the new `fuse_when_shortseq` gating increases fuse preference prematurely, causing frequent kernel fallbacks and thrashing the KV eviction path.

meenal: that matches traces: frequent kernel handoffs cause KV cache to lose locality (KV entries tied to kernel instance layout). Evictions spike, next requests miss and fall back to slower code path. Net latency up.

sasha: can we revert the heuristic or add a guard (min-stable-window) to avoid flip-flopping during warmup? Quick mitigation: force fallback bias to `attn_generic` for shortseq until warmup stabilizes.

perf-bot: Alert `decode_p95` created ticket INFR-1429 and annotated with run IDs.

tyler: I'm drafting a revert PR that undoes fuse_when_shortseq and adds a shortseq stability-window. Will post link in a minute. Holding the server rollout now. :hand:

jordan: suggested hotfix patch in case revert is too heavy: change selector from `score_delta > 0.2` to `> 0.35` for fused candidate so we require stronger signal. Minimal change, should reduce flips.

sasha: canary weight -> 5% -> 0% for this runtime release? ops, please pause rollout.

infra-bot: rollout paused by @tyler at 2026-03-18T10:20Z.

meenal: I'll run a repro job with the selector tweak and attach traces. If it stabilizes KV evict_rate -> good. If not, revert.

tyler: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4221 (revert fuse_when_shortseq). Added note: revert + stability-window of 30s for kernel preference.

jordan: bisect result summary in PR: 4f3b2a13 introduced the regression, linking perf artifacts.

sasha: thanks — once we have a green perf run on repro, we can unpause. Keep perf-bot watching. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: re-run scheduled (repro/job-587) — will post results to this thread.

tyler: TL;DR — root cause: selector heuristic caused kernel oscillation during warmup -> KV cache locality lost -> evictions up -> decode p95 regression. Mitigation path: revert heuristic + add stability window; hotfix selector threshold if we need faster patch.
